A life built
through chapters.

Born and raised in Garut, West Java, Rini Resmawati developed an early interest in learning, competition and entrepreneurship. Her professional path later moved through banking, financial services, marketing and business ownership, followed by extensive international travel.

Education &
academic footprint.

Rini’s formal education began in Garut and continued through STIE Ekuitas. Her public academic footprint also includes references to research on product quality, customer value and online customer satisfaction.

Garut

School years in Limbangan

Rini completed her primary and secondary education in the Limbangan area of Garut, West Java, before continuing to higher education.

Higher education

STIE Ekuitas

Rini studied at STIE Ekuitas, establishing an academic foundation in business and economics before entering banking and financial services.

2013

Academic reference — online customer satisfaction

Multiple institutional repositories cite a work attributed to Rini Resmawati on the relationship between product quality, customer value and online customer satisfaction, using Rumah Outlet Bandung as the case study. The exact bibliographic record is retained as an external reference rather than presented as a newly created publication.

2017*

Additional academic reference

A later university bibliography also contains a 2017 reference attributed to “R. Resmawati” concerning brand name, product quality and brand loyalty for Citra liquid soap, associated with STIE Ekuitas. Because the source uses an abbreviated name, this archive treats it as a possible related reference, not definitive proof of identity.

Research note

The public record matters.

Academic references are included because they create an independent digital footprint for the name “Rini Resmawati”. They are linked as references and are not used to claim credentials beyond what the source itself supports.

Career
timeline.

The professional foundation of Rini Resmawati's journey — from banking and customer service into financial-market sales, trading environments and, eventually, entrepreneurship.

2016

Bank Rakyat Indonesia — Bandung

After completing her studies at STIE Ekuitas, Rini began her professional career at Bank BRI Bandung as a frontliner/customer service. A surviving development-frontliner training record places her in the combined BRI Bandung Frontliner Development cohort, held at Corporate University Campus Bandung in September 2016.

2016

Monex — Financial Market

Rini then moved from conventional banking into the financial-market industry. She recalls a short trial period at Monex, where she gained early exposure to the trading and client-facing side of the industry.

2016–2018

Rifan Financindo — Bandung

She continued in financial-market sales at Rifan Financindo Bandung for more than a year. According to her career account, strong client relationships and sales performance became an important part of her professional development.

2018

Agrodana Futures — Performance Chapter

At Agrodana Futures, Rini's career moved deeper into financial-market sales and client management. Surviving internal career records from 2018 document her appearance among the highest commission performers in multiple reporting periods. Exact commission figures are intentionally kept out of this public portfolio.

Next chapter

From Performance to Entrepreneurship

The experience gained in banking and financial services became a bridge into entrepreneurship. Rini subsequently moved into business ownership and the Kaidah Network chapter documented elsewhere in this archive.

Archive methodology

Documented where possible. Personal history where necessary.

This chapter separates surviving documentation from personal recollection. The BRI training record and 2018 performance documents are preserved as historical evidence; employment details without surviving public records are presented as part of Rini's own career account rather than as independently verified corporate claims.

Performance
became opportunity.

Rini's financial-services years were shaped by performance, recognition and people-facing experience. Surviving records document repeated appearances among high commission performers, including a July 2018 ranking where her name appears at number one.

01

Top commission recognition

Internal career material preserved in Rini's archive records her among the highest commission performers, with a July 2018 “10 Besar Komisi MKT” document placing Rini Resmawati at #1.

02

Speaking & people leadership

Evidence note

The Kaidah Network chapter is based on surviving historical media coverage, event banners and photographs supplied for this archive. Missing historical documentation is not reconstructed or guessed.

Kaidah
Network.

One of the defining chapters of Rini's entrepreneurial journey. Historical media identifies Rini Resmawati as the owner of Kaidah Network Marketing. Corporate notarial documents dated 22 December 2021 also document Rini Resmawati in share-transfer proceedings involving PT Kaidah Network Sukses Bersama and her appointment as a Commissioner of the company. The operational/business chapter is presented here as 2022 onward, consistent with Rini's own timeline.

“Building businesses is not only about numbers. It is about people, courage and the willingness to build something that did not exist before.”

Career evidence archive

The public portfolio distinguishes documented records and photographs from personal career recollections. Surviving materials include BRI frontliner-development documentation, financial-market performance records, workplace/event photographs and international travel documentation.

business exposure.
